2116623584479019136.en_summary: As $TSLA EV share has declined steadily from 80% to the current 52%, who has gained share? Mathematically, market share has to equal 100%, so someone is gaining share if not the 7 listed.
2116623584479019136.zh_summary: $TSLA 電動車市佔率已由 80% 穩步下降至目前的 52%，是誰獲得了市佔？數學上，市佔率必須等於 100%，因此若非所列 7 家，必有其他業者獲得市佔。

2116620153001586849.en_summary: Even with first-mover and cost/scale advantages, TSLA is losing EV share in the U.S. to no-name manufacturers. If Hyundai, Honda, and Kia can gain share, TSLA will continue to lose as others enter. Absent proactive marketing, share deterioration continues, making it impossible to justify TSLA’s multiple. $TSLA bulls ignore the volume growth and P/E relationship.
2116620153001586849.zh_summary: 即使擁有先發與成本／規模優勢，TSLA 仍在美國電動車市場失去市佔給無名製造商。若現代、本田與起亞能獲得市佔，隨著其他業者進入，TSLA 將持續失去市佔。缺乏積極行銷，市佔惡化將持續，數學上無法支持 TSLA 的倍數。$TSLA 多頭忽略成交量增長與本益比的關係。
